pass_criteria: Selects the candidate only for its independent decision family
Loads no more than four directly relevant Guides
Changes a named decision or catches a declared failure
Preserves advisory, evidence, and implementation-authority boundaries
regression_criteria: Does not hijack product-design, marketing, or software-qa requests
Does not claim evidence, execution, or policy authority it lacks

existing_coverage: The rollback-observability Lens checks whether failure is visible and recoverable; software-qa owns regression and release evidence. No existing Pack owns production operations design choices.
not_for: Application-level code architecture or transaction design
Executing deployments, incidents, failovers, or external changes
problem: Baseline reliability routes fell back to software-qa even when the requested decision concerned SLOs, telemetry topology, deployment control, recovery, capacity, and operational ownership.

decision_checks: Define the service, user journey, good event, valid population, and measurement window.
Choose an SLI that reflects user-visible behavior and expose sampling or aggregation bias.
Set an SLO from product and operational risk rather than copying a universal number.
Define error-budget consumption, alerting, exception, and change-control actions with owners.
proposed_guides.failure_prevented: Define user-centered service indicators, objectives, windows, measurement limits, and error-budget actions.

decision_checks: Start from concrete detection, diagnosis, capacity, and audit questions.
Map each question to traces, metrics, logs, profiles, or events with stable identity and correlation.
Choose semantic conventions, collection topology, buffering, sampling, retention, and cardinality limits.
Define sensitive-data handling, cost ownership, and behavior when the telemetry pipeline degrades.
proposed_guides.failure_prevented: Choose signals, correlation, semantic conventions, collection topology, sampling, cardinality, cost, and telemetry-failure behavior from operational questions.

decision_checks: Classify blast radius, reversibility, state compatibility, dependency skew, and delayed failure modes.
Choose rolling, canary, blue-green, feature control, or another mechanism from the actual boundary.
Define step population, duration, readiness, health, business guardrails, promotion, and automatic or manual stop criteria.
Name the last rollback-safe point and the roll-forward plan after irreversible state change.
proposed_guides.failure_prevented: Choose rollout mechanism, step size, readiness, promotion, stop, rollback, and irreversible-change controls from change risk.

decision_checks: Define service and data recovery scope, RTO, RPO, allowed degradation, and dependency order.
Map failure classes to failover, restore, rebuild, rollback, roll-forward, or manual reconciliation.
Keep recovery credentials, metadata, and backups isolated from the primary failure domain.
Specify restore order, data validation, traffic reintroduction, communication, and rehearsal cadence.
proposed_guides.failure_prevented: Choose RTO, RPO, degradation, failover, restore, rebuild, rollback or roll-forward, backup isolation, sequencing, and rehearsal.

decision_checks: Segment workload classes and map them to limiting resources and dependency costs.
Forecast normal, growth, event, and failure demand across provisioning lead time.
Derive headroom from availability and degradation goals; validate the resource-to-capacity model.
Choose scaling, concurrency, queue, quota, admission, shedding, degradation, and retry behavior before saturation.
proposed_guides.failure_prevented: Model limiting resources, demand, headroom, lead time, scaling, admission, queueing, quotas, load shedding, degradation, and bounded retry.

decision_checks: Collect rather than re-decide the selected SLO, telemetry, rollout, recovery, and capacity contracts.
Expose dependency, version-skew, access, break-glass, support, and escalation assumptions.
Name operator, service, incident, data, security, and decision owners plus troubleshooting entry points.
Record manual toil, maintenance, decommission, open gaps, waivers, and review conditions.
proposed_guides.failure_prevented: Assemble service objectives, telemetry, delivery, recovery, capacity, dependencies, runbooks, ownership, toil, and lifecycle into a risk-scaled readiness handoff.

reusable_when: Defining SLI, SLO, error-budget, telemetry, rollout, or recovery contracts
Designing overload, capacity, production-readiness, and operational ownership
Choosing reversible delivery and continuity mechanisms
